name: iPollo Design
description: 为当前 Design 会话提供网站与应用界面、海报与卡片、文章与报告、PPT 和其他设计的 Agent Skills。

composer.prompt: 使用 iPollo Design 在当前会话的设计项目中创建或编辑内容。

en.description: Official Design Skills for websites and app interfaces, posters and cards, articles and reports, PPT and other designs.

composer.prompt: Use iPollo Design to create or edit content in the current session's design project.

ipollowork-design-studio.label: Design Routing and Other Designs
ipollowork-design-studio.description: Route the current Design category to its specialist Skill and create or edit other designs.

ipollowork-design-web.label: Websites and App Interfaces
ipollowork-design-web.description: Create and edit websites, landing pages, application screens and interactive prototypes.

ipollowork-design-graphics.label: Posters and Cards
ipollowork-design-graphics.description: Create and edit posters, banners and social card series with their intended canvas and editable content.

ipollowork-design-editorial.label: Articles and Reports
ipollowork-design-editorial.description: Create and edit articles, WeChat reading pages and reports while preserving facts, evidence and reading flow.

ipollowork-presentations.label: PPT Presentations
ipollowork-presentations.description: Create, revise, and inspect presentations in the current Design session.

workspace-read.reason: Read user-selected design files, templates, and design tokens from the current session.

workspace-write.reason: Update design or presentation files in the current session as requested by the user.

permissions.reason: 读取当前会话中用户选择的设计文件、模板和设计 Token。
按照用户要求更新当前会话的设计或演示文稿文件。

resources.label: 设计总入口与其他设计
resources.description: 按当前 Design 分类转交专业 Skill，并创建或修改其他设计。

resources.label: 网站与应用界面
resources.description: 创建或修改网站、落地页、应用界面、仪表盘和交互原型。

resources.label: 海报与卡片
resources.description: 在指定画布中创建或修改海报、横幅和社交卡片系列，保留可编辑内容。

resources.label: 文章与报告
resources.description: 创建或修改文章、微信阅读页面和研究报告，保留事实、证据与阅读顺序。

resources.label: PPT 演示文稿
resources.description: 在当前 Design 会话中制作、修改和检查演示文稿。
